passages.text: A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A song.
passages.sermon: The sons of Korah wrote this psalm.\r\nThis psalm is a song.

passages.text: He has founded His city on the holy mountains.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
The sons of Korah wrote this psalm.
This psalm is a song.
God founded His city.
God built His city on the holy mountains.
passages.original: לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֭רַח מִזְמ֣וֹר שִׁ֑יר יְ֝סוּדָת֗וֹ בְּהַרְרֵי־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD loves the gates of Zion.
Zion is God's holy city.
Jacob is the ancestor of Israel.
Jacob's dwellings are the places where his descendants live.
The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
passages.original: אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֭הוָה שַׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֝כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me— along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush — when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The city of God is Zion.
God calls Zion His city.
People say glorious things about Zion.
Pause and reflect on this.
God says, “I will mention Rahab and Babylon.
These are nations that know Me.
I will also mention Philistia, Tyre, and Cush.
I will say about them, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”
passages.original: נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑ךְ עִ֖יר הָאֱלֹהִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃ אַזְכִּ֤יר׀ רַ֥הַב וּבָבֶ֗ל לְֽיֹ֫דְעָ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְצ֣וֹר עִם־ כּ֑וּשׁ זֶ֝֗ה יֻלַּד־ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”
passages.sermon:
Zion is the city of God.
People will say about Zion, “This person was born in her.”
They will also say, “That person was born in her.”
The Most High is God.
God Himself will make Zion strong.
God will establish Zion.
passages.original: וּֽלֲצִיּ֨וֹן׀ יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִישׁ יֻלַּד־ בָּ֑הּ וְה֖וּא יְכוֹנְנֶ֣הָ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD will write in the book of the nations.
The LORD will say, “This person was born in Zion.”
Selah.
Singers will speak.
Pipers will play.
They will say, “All my sources of joy are in you, Zion.”
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְפֹּר בִּכְת֣וֹב עַמִּ֑ים זֶ֖ה יֻלַּד־ שָׁ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃ וְשָׁרִ֥ים כְּחֹלְלִ֑ים כָּֽל־ מַעְיָנַ֥י בָּֽךְ׃
